2. Ask
who is heavier between men and women ? what is the proportion of men and women ? how does waist size vary for men and women ? how does hip size vary for men and women ? how does chest size vary for men and women ? what are the age ranges in the given data set? what is the variation in chest size in the given data set? what is the variation in waist size in the given data set? what is the variation in hip size in the given data set? what is the variation in height in the given data set? what is the variation in weight in the given data set? who is taller between men and women? which sex has a larger variation in the age range?


3. Choose a mark
Who is heavier between men and women ? -Histogram
What is the proportion of men and women ? -Bar
How does waist size vary for men and women ? -Histogram
How does hip size vary for men and women ? -Density
How does chest size vary for men and women ? -Density
which sex has a larger variation in the age range in the given data-set ? -Histogram
Who is taller between men and women ? -Histogram
what are the age ranges in the given data set? -Bar
what is the variation in chest size in the given data set? -Density
what is the variation in waist size in the given data set? -Density
what is the variation in hip size in the given data set? -Density
what is the variation in height in the given data set? -Density
what is the variation in weight in the given data set? -Density


4. Predict
Referring to a stereotypical human anatomy, we predict that the variation in chest size and hip size would larger for women than men.


5. Make
Who is heavier between men and women ?

myPanelAData |> gf_histogram(~weight_kg,fill =~sex,bins = 50)

6. Say
We all found the density graph comparing chest sizes of men and women interesting because according to the graph, men have a bigger chest size than women which is quite unexpected. Men also have larger variation in the sizes while women have more difference in density for different sizes. This is surprising because according to the bar graph, the ratio of women is slightly more than men, in comparison. We also found the density graph comparing hip size of men and women surprising because it is contrasting the general belief that women have wider hips.

2. Ask
does the education of a person affect their opinion on whether marijuana should be legal or not?


3. Choose a mark
does the education of a person affect their opinion on whether marijuana should be legal or not? - mosaic graph


4. Predict
we predict that a person pursuing a higher education degree would want marijuana to be legal, to regulate stress levels and mental health.


5. Make

6. Say
Looking at the graph, the ratio of people who think marijuana should be legal and not legal appears to be similar, in each individual degree. Saying that, it is surprising information to see that the percentage of high schoolers who want marijuana to be legal is way larger than any other degrees. This could also be because the number of high schoolers in this data set is more.
